httpComparison.normalization: Only registered run/entity IDs and validated timestamps. Exact frozen DTO regex metadata stays literal only after same-case request/status/full-body verification. Timestamp equality, request bounds, immutable history, row/session deltas and wire-to-PG milliseconds are checked first. Membership/user observer relation sets sort by registered ID. The unique regression:current-session body.permissions and body.user.permissions use R1C-CP07 set comparison only after exact case/source and37-string unique complete-set/raw-array-equality checks; every other response/tree/role/audit/children array retains order. JSON Content-Length is checked against each endpoint actual bytes; successful HEAD checks its own GET length. Raw responses and lengths remain in input reports.

concurrencyComparison.boundary: Six controlled schedules in five row-lock-provable categories. Nullable alias read-between-SELECT merge is explicitly not claimed by these row locks.
concurrencyComparison.normalization: Only registered IDs/run strings and valid timestamps after request bounds, immutable prefixes, exact versions, date precision, TTL/time equality, full rows and precise lock/phase/owner validation. No response, tree, audit or child array sorting.
